[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Magdalene was born in 1664. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1149|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Laurimer-1|Eupham Laurimer]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1149]] is assessed at 48% (possible). Magdalene's 14 August 1664 Edinburgh index names Robert Glasgow and Eupham Loremer. The Lorimer surname and Edinburgh child sequence identify the same adult parental household, while the 1627-child mapping remains unproved. The 1644 married cordiner evidence concerns that adult household only.

Possible identification with Robert-1149; direct paternity for the record-defined Lorimer father does not itself settle his birth or ancestry.

Next useful test: Test the adult father through Lorimer property and trade associates.

Source basis already held: [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1Y6-B4V "Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", , FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1Y6-B4V : 11 February 2020), Magdalene Glasgow, 1664.].
